items.title: Rwanda to host hub for rejected EU migrants
items.desc: In tonight's edition: Five European countries are negotiating a deal to deport rejected asylum seekers to Rwanda. Also, DR Congo and Rwanda's political animosity spills over at the Francophonie Summit in Cambodia. Plus in Tunisia, young women are increasingly turning towards weightlifting and bodybuilding as a form of self-expression.

items.title: Pope Leo hit by flying rosary while waving to crowds in Peru
items.desc: The pontiff was struck in the face by what is thought to be prayer beads while travelling aboard the popemobile to deliver a farewell Mass.
